purpose: Heavy Rebuild clean-master architectural program for a ruined multi-level parking garage with coherent vehicle circulation, pedestrian egress, structural bays, ramps, and service functions.
architectural_rules: Vehicle entry must connect continuously through drive aisles and supported ramps to represented parking levels.
Ramps must maintain drivable width, headroom, landing support, and plausible turning geometry.
Pedestrian egress must be distinct from primary vehicle ramps and provide at least one traceable protected route to street level.
Columns, shear walls, beams, and deck edges must establish a credible repetitive parking-structure grid.
Localized deck failure must terminate at plausible structural boundaries rather than producing arbitrary floating slabs.

damage_doctrine.intent: Partially collapsed parking structure whose repetitive structural grid and circulation remain readable and traversable.
